title: Battle of Alcolea (1868)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Alcolea (1868)", at revision 1370431526, opens: "The Battle of Alcolea took place on 28 September 1868, over a bridge above Guadalquivir river in the town of Alcolea, Córdoba, Spain. In this battle, revolutionary forces led by General Francisco Serrano y Domínguez defeated Queen Isabella II of Spain's governmental forces commanded by general Manuel Pavía, forcing her to leave Spain and be exiled in France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q612176, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle in Spain 1868". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
